#                                             byte count / length / count / size / flags / mode / prot / alignment;
#                                             `addr` = an address / pointer (never settles by type); `checkval` = a

#                                             ret: int:<type> (an integer return), ptr:<type>, void:void,

# BYHAND   fn  word-off  reading:N  cmp-off  citation      a table read entry by entry (the tool checks the bound)
# LUI      fn  lui-off  use-off  role  class  citation      one use of one lui value
